name: Input layout
author: Jordan Kicklighter
description: Tray widget for the active xkb keyboard layout and variant. Left-click opens a flyout to pick the active layout; right-click or scroll cycles layouts, middle-click cycles back. Use the gear to pick which layouts are enabled.

barWidget.description: Active xkb layout+variant label. Left-click opens the layout flyout, right-click or scroll cycles layouts, middle-click cycles back. Manage enabled layouts via the gear.
